<FeatureTable template="py-worker" />

## Notes

- **`temporal`** works on the default Python image; its wheels include musl and
  glibc builds.
- **`telemetry`** off removes every OpenTelemetry package; the job wrapper and
  `setup_telemetry()` calls go with it.
